payload.author: Juan Lentino
payload.content:
The verifier is the trust surface, and this fixture is its witness.

Five hotfixes landed in its decision paths in one day. Every one was caught live, after deploy, by a person reading a docket.

This record exists so the sixth is caught here, offline, before a deploy.

Same words in the same order. That is the whole match semantic; paragraph breaks carry no provenance.
payload.title: Fixture: the docket witness
